Carla is a car rental app comparing 900 companies including Hertz, Avis, Budget, Dollar, Thrifty, Sixt and many local rent a car companies. Featured on USA TODAY, Techcrunch, Boston Globe, Travel Pulse and AutoRental News. 2.5M+ rental cars selected annually on Carla.

How can Carla help you to book your next trip? 

• Search airport, city, address or hotel and voila you will see all rental cars.
• See all rental cars nearby on the map. Check if the branches are open or not. 
• Instant confirmation: Get your voucher email right after booking.
• Under 25 fee waived: We're waiving under 25 fee at participating companies.
• One way: Drop off at a different location.
• Get free upgrades.
• Last minute deals: Daily deals starting from $9/day.
• 24/7 customer service: Don't wait on the line for hours. We're here to help in seconds. 

You can rent a car at 20,000 locations worldwide from all major companies like Avis, Budget, Dollar, Fox, Sixt, Hertz, Thrifty, Europcar and many local businesses. 

- Big savings with best car rental deals.
- Hassle-free car reservation in seconds. Don't get lost in a never ending list of cars.
- No hidden fees. Never overpay at the counter.

Unlock Hidden Discounts: Discover an array of secret deals and discounts available exclusively on the Carla app. Unleash your savings potential and get access to offers you won't find anywhere else.

Unbeatable Prices: We've partnered with top car rental companies to secure the best rates on the market. You can now book your dream car at a fraction of the cost, leaving you with more money to splurge on your trip.

Hand-Picked Selection: Our team of travel experts scours the globe to bring you a hand-picked selection of premium vehicles and deals. From luxury sedans to rugged SUVs, find the perfect wheels for your journey with ease.

Exclusive Hidden Gems: Experience destinations like a true local. Discover hidden gems and off-the-beaten-path spots that only insiders know about. Uncover the essence of your destination, one road trip at a time.

Faster Booking, More Adventure: Our streamlined booking process ensures that you can secure your car rental in seconds. Spend less time planning and more time exploring your destination.

Global Reach: Whether you're venturing across your home country or exploring a far-off land, Secret Deals are available in 20,000+ locations worldwide. No matter where your wanderlust takes you, Carla has you covered.
